items.title: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
items.summary: First extragalactic globular cluster stellar stream identified; used to map dark matter distribution around distant galaxy, opens new detection method.

items.title: Newton’s 300-year-old law just passed its biggest test yet
items.summary: Gravity tested across galaxy clusters at hundreds of millions of light-years; confirms Einstein/Newton predictions, strengthens dark matter model over modified gravity.

items.title: Magnetic field first kills superconductor, then brings it back to life
items.summary: Re-entrant superconductivity observed in 2D material for first time; magnetic field suppresses then restores superconducting state, revealing new mechanism.

items.title: On Cloud 9: Have astronomers discovered the first starless galaxy?
items.summary: First starless galaxy candidate discovered; dark matter-dominated system with minimal stars challenges formation theories and dark matter understanding.

items.title: Realization of Air-Stable Two-Dimensional Superconductor Nb2Pd3Te5 With Quasi-One-Dimensional Pair Density Modulation
items.summary: First air-stable 2D superconductor Nb2Pd3Te5 synthesized with quasi-1D pair density modulation; enables robust platform for anisotropic superconducting devices.

items.title: Electrical manipulation of oxygen stoichiometry in multiterminal YBaCuO junctions
items.summary: Electrical control of oxygen stoichiometry demonstrated in YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ three-terminal junctions, enabling tunable superconducting device properties via oxygen migration.

items.title: First Plasma Commissioning and Operational Highlights from India's First Spherical Tokamak at IPR
items.summary: India's first spherical tokamak commissioned at IPR; achieved first plasma experiments with Ohmic heating and microwave assist, enabling low-cost study of compact tokamak physics.
